definitions.gloss: complete set; full kit; everything needed
definitions.explanation: A full set of items that together form a complete collection or kit. Used when referring to all the necessary items for a particular purpose.

examples.japanese: {工具|こうぐ}{一式|いっしき}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a complete set of tools.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}{一式|いっしき}を{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。
examples.english: Please submit the full set of documents.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{際|さい}に{家具|かぐ}{一式|いっしき}を{新|あたら}しく{揃|そろ}えることにした。
examples.english: When moving, I decided to get a complete new set of furniture.

notes:
USAGE:
{一式|いっしき} follows the noun it modifies, forming a compound: {道具|どうぐ}{一式|いっしき} (a full set of tools), {書類|しょるい}{一式|いっしき} (a complete set of documents).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {書類|しょるい}{一式|いっしき} (full set of documents)
- {道具|どうぐ}{一式|いっしき} (complete set of tools)
- {家具|かぐ}{一式|いっしき} (complete set of furniture)
- {一式|いっしき}{揃|そろ}える (to assemble a full set)
